scenarios.title: Create and publish a popup through the admin editor (delay 3s, session_once on)
scenarios.evidence: Editor shows published popup; popup row appears in list; screenshot 01

scenarios.title: Published popup appears on the public front only after the configured delay
scenarios.evidence: Public page /smoke-574: no dialog at t=0, dialog mounts at ~3s; screenshot 02

scenarios.title: Popup close control dismisses the dialog and does not re-open on the same session
scenarios.evidence: Close button clicked; sessionStorage persistence keeps it dismissed after navigation

scenarios.title: session_once popup survives navigation but returns exactly once after sessionStorage is cleared
scenarios.evidence: After clearing sessionStorage and reloading, exactly 1 dialog mounts (generation guard prevents duplicate watchers); screenshot 03
